name: flow-mcp
description: Drive Google Flow (Veo and Imagen) from an agent: images, videos, characters, voices, edits, scenes, and Flow Agent chat.

interface.shortDescription: Make images and videos with Google Flow
interface.longDescription: Registers the flow-mcp MCP server and adds a skill that checks the session, asks for the Google sign-in one time, waits for jobs, and warns before it uses many credits. Needs Node.js and Google Chrome on this computer.
defaultPrompt: Draw a red paper lantern with Google Flow.
Make a short video clip with Google Flow.
